data.name: Türkiye

sources.label: Freedom House: country electoral and political indicators, 2026 edition

legitimacy.summary:
Our assessment: Türkiye has significant electoral concerns. The latest country evidence records weaknesses affecting the electoral mandate of the national executive; the electoral mandate of the legislature; fair and impartial electoral rules; independent party organisation. These conditions warrant caution about equal participation and accountability. The rating does not, by itself, establish that a particular declared winner was incorrect.

Evidence baseline: Freedom in the World 2026, covering conditions in 2025. Our review date is not the date of an observer verdict on a later ballot; subsequent contests may require a separate assessment.

data.coverageNote: Selected records only. Earlier elections and additional result detail are still being added.
